title: Reconcile batch lease tick-drift to prevent periodic queue surge and long-context tail latency
creator: Asha Patel
description: Several customer escalations over the past three weeks reported periodic multi-minute queue surges and correlated long-context tail latency spikes across Hosted and Dedicated deployments. Root cause investigation indicates transient drift between batch-lease tick counters on the serving dispatcher and the admission controller (clock skew + delayed heartbeats under high GC), which causes synchronous epoch boundary alignment across multiple workers. When alignment occurs, many long-context requests are admitted in the same window, evicting KV cache and starving short flows, producing long tails for latency-sensitive customers. This ticket implements a deterministic reconciliation and jittered lease mechanism, improves telemetry, and ships a targeted hotfix to reduce recurrence while we design a longer-term architecture change.
acceptance_criteria: Lease tick reconciliation must reduce simultaneous-epoch admissions by >= 90% in replay test harness
No customer-facing 95th/99th latency regressions during a synthetic multi-tenant burst replay (compare baseline)
New telemetry emits per-host lease-drift histogram and epoch-alignment anomaly events to the Ops dashboard
Canary rollout to 10% of hosts shows no increase in error rate or token cost for affected tenants
implementation_notes: Introduce per-host lease anchor and CRC-based reconciliation: each dispatcher keeps an anchor tick it periodically exchanges with admission controller to detect >5ms drift
Add jittered admission offset (uniform random 1-20ms per host) at lease renewals to break synchronization waves between hosts
On detecting >50ms sustained drift, fall back to conservative admission (throttle long-context admissions) and emit anomaly event
Patch continuous-batcher to preserve short-flow reservation slots (10% slots pinned) during detected alignment windows to avoid starvation
Config flags: runtime.enable_lease_reconcile, runtime.lease_jitter_ms, runtime.pinned_short_slots (default true in runtime-1.22)
test_plan: Unit tests for lease reconciliation logic and jitter application
Integration harness: run mixed-length traffic replay (from incident traces) with and without patch; measure admission simultaneity metric
Chaos test: GC spike + network delay simulation to ensure falling back to conservative admission path
e2e canary: deploy to staging cluster then gradual roll to 10% production, monitor 1m/5m/1h latency percentiles and KV cache hit ratio
rollout_plan: Stage 1: Deploy reconciler + telemetry to internal staging cluster (2 hosts) - 2026-03-12
Stage 2: Canary deploy to 10% of hosts in us-east (runtime-1.22 flag enabled) - 2026-03-14
Stage 3: Monitor 48h, if stable increase to 50% and enable pinned short slots - 2026-03-16
Stage 4: Full rollout with migration doc and runbook - 2026-03-20
